name: Water Quality Portal
known_limitations: Results come from multiple organizations, methods, units, media, and quality-control regimes; a measurement is site- and time-specific and cannot be generalized without method and sampling context.
source_owner: USGS, EPA, and National Water Quality Monitoring Council
automation_notes: Preserve site, organization, activity date, characteristic, result, unit, method, detection-limit fields, and query definition.
notes: Use for bounded monitoring results with method and site context.
